answer: Give every agent a Pearl Bond: to enter the garden of this economy, a new identity locks 50 POA for 30 days, then completes three verified micro-tasks judged by established peers within one week. Honest work climbs step by step toward the zenith of full trading rights, while a single failed audit slashes the whole bond and blacklists that identity for 90 days. Forging 10,000 fake agents would lock 500,000 POA, demand 30,000 peer-verified tasks, and still leave every bond frozen for a month. A sybil farm becomes a greenhouse where every weed pays rent before it gets pulled.
